title: How the shop page is arranged
question: The shop keeps mori's current look. Lock an arrangement, steer, or ask for another set.

options.label: The request is the shelf
options.thesis: Every product is a choice on one request sheet, so asking is the same gesture as browsing.
options.viewport: One inset sheet: three groups of product choices, then name, phone, and Gửi yêu cầu along the bottom.
options.risk: Reads as a form. A guest who wanted to linger over products gets little to look at.

options.label: Gifts on the counter
options.thesis: Gift sets lead, because they can leave the studio without a treatment. Face and body wait in the next band.
options.viewport: One gift set fills the view with its price and the request fields on it. Face and body begin as a ruled list at the bottom edge.
options.risk: Puts gifts ahead of face and body, which the catalog treats as equals.

options.label: Slip, then the shelf
options.thesis: The request sits first as a short slip. The grouped shelf explains the products underneath.
options.viewport: A full-width slip with name, phone, product, and send. The face shelf starts immediately below as its own section.
options.risk: The shelf is what you came to browse, and it begins only after the form.
